en.headline: Hong Kong Food Carnival opens Saturday at Kwai Chung Sports Ground
en.dek: The 13th edition runs 24 October to 1 November with more than 330 booths, a new Southeast Asian food zone and a Beyblade tournament.
body: The 13th Hong Kong Food Carnival opens on Saturday at Kwai Chung Sports Ground and runs until 1 November, according to the Chinese Manufacturers’ Association of Hong Kong, the organiser.

The event features more than 330 outdoor booths across seven thematic zones, including a new Southeast Asian food zone and about 80 cooked-food stalls. Admission is HK$6, with free entry from 7 p.m.; children under one metre, seniors aged 65 and above, and persons with disabilities enter free.

Highlights include a Beyblade X S1 tournament on the first two days and Halloween activities on 30 and 31 October. The organisers said limited items would be offered at HK$1 or 10 per cent off on opening and closing days.

zh.headline: 第13屆香港美食嘉年華周六葵涌運動場開幕
zh.dek: 活動由10月24日至11月1日舉行，設逾330個攤位、全新東南亞美食區及爆旋陀螺賽事。
body: 香港中華廠商聯合會主辦的第13屆香港美食嘉年華將於周六在葵涌運動場開幕，至11月1日結束。
現場設逾330個戶外攤位，分為七大主題區，包括全新東南亞美食區及約80檔熟食攤位。入場費6元，晚上7時起免費；身高1米或以下小童、65歲或以上長者及殘疾人士免費入場。
亮點包括首兩日的爆旋陀螺S1街霸戰，以及10月30及31日的萬聖節活動。主辦方表示，開幕及閉幕日部分貨品會以1元或一折限量發售。
